rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt: ONE original square premium cinematic painterly illustration of Gnefro, the small rough-wrinkled water sprite of Umbria. Depict a very ancient craggy small humanoid under one meter, two ordinary human eyes deeply recessed under heavy weathered brow, rough coarse folded skin like an elderly river hermit, thin natural lips with only one corner lifted in a knowing mischievous half-smile. Absolutely NOT a cute round-cheeked gnome, cartoon, child, mascot, oversized eyes or red nose; no pointed ears, no cap. He remains benign and quietly playful, never evil. MOMENT: leaning forward close to viewer, his OWN BODY physically becoming clear ordinary river water [gnefro-c07]; both lower legs and one arm are completely liquid, the right half of the wrinkled cheek and neck now liquid water flowing directly into his shoulder, but ONE HEAD still coherently visible. Solid humanlike half and clear watery half of face show the startling transformation. The liquid hand reaches out immediately next to camera and breaks into large weighty droplets. Torso covered by entirely OPAQUE thick dark coarse tunic and trousers, no transparent clothes. CAMERA extreme low macro view; face and transforming hand fill almost entire frame, nearby adult boot at right gives honest small size [gnefro-c02/c03]. SETTING river Nera at Marmore falls, very dark dusk with only thin amber horizon behind and one narrow warm sidelight [gnefro-c01/c06]. Deep black shadows, austere sober expression, awe through impossible physical self-transformation, no control of river/weather, no generic magical glow, beams or energy ribbons. Photographically tangible wet surfaces and aged skin, mature dignified face rather than appealing toy design. No blood/gore, no text/signatures/symbols/borders/watermarks, no franchise designs. One head, two arms, two legs in process of turning into water, no additional limbs.
